blogs.title: Behind the Scenes of FlashAttention‑3: How Asynchrony Turns Sparse GPU Workloads into a Continuous Flow
blogs.description: Dive into the warp‑specialization technique that decouples memory bandwidth from compute on Hopper GPUs. We’ll break down the producer‑consumer model, explain how TMA and Tensor Cores operate independently, and show why overlapping data movement with matrix multiplication gives attention a massive speed boost.

blogs.title: GEMM meets Softmax: The 2‑Stage Pipeline That Keeps Attention Throttling
blogs.description: Explains the clever reordering that lets a softmax calculation run while a matrix multiplication finishes. Readers will learn about the traditional bottlenecks in self‑attention, how the new pipelined design hides latency, and the real‑world gains you can expect in forward and backward passes.

blogs.title: FP8 is Not a Myth: Making Ultra‑Low Precision Work for Transformers
blogs.description: Unpack the challenges of running attention in FP8, from layout constraints to quantization noise. This post reviews block quantization and incoherent processing—two tricks that keep FP8 accuracy close to FP16 while doubling raw throughput—and why these innovations matter for next‑generation large‑model training.

blogs.title: From Paper to Production: How FlashAttention‑3 Will Fit Into Your PyTorch / Hugging Face Stack
blogs.description: Walk through the practical steps of integrating FlashAttention‑3, including API usage, CUDA kernel compilation, and GPU profiling tips. We’ll also discuss compatibility with existing inference pipelines and highlight any bottlenecks that may still exist for long‑context workloads.
